title: Enterprise Architecture Patterns - Quiz
description: Test your mastery of advanced PEGA enterprise architecture patterns, design principles, and scalable system design methodologies

questions.question: What is the most critical component of scalable enterprise PEGA architecture design?
options: Multi-tier architecture with clear separation of concerns and independent scaling capabilities
questions.explanation: Multi-tier architecture with clear separation enables independent scaling, evolution, and maintenance of different system layers while supporting enterprise-scale requirements.

questions.question: For enterprise microservices integration with PEGA, what pattern provides optimal resilience?
options: Event-driven architecture with circuit breakers, saga patterns, and graceful degradation
questions.explanation: Event-driven architecture with resilience patterns ensures fault tolerance, loose coupling, and graceful degradation in distributed enterprise systems.

questions.question: What is essential for distributed transaction management in enterprise PEGA architectures?
options: Saga pattern with compensation logic and eventual consistency
questions.explanation: Saga pattern provides reliable distributed transaction management through orchestrated steps and compensation logic while maintaining system performance.

questions.question: For enterprise API gateway implementation, what capabilities are most critical?
options: Authentication, rate limiting, request transformation, monitoring, and circuit breaking
questions.explanation: Comprehensive API gateway capabilities provide centralized cross-cutting concerns while ensuring security, performance, and observability.

questions.question: What approach provides optimal data consistency in event-sourced PEGA architectures?
options: Event sourcing with CQRS and eventual consistency with compensation patterns
questions.explanation: Event sourcing with CQRS enables scalable read/write optimization while eventual consistency with compensation provides reliable data management.

questions.question: For enterprise architectural governance, what assessment approach is most comprehensive?
options: Automated compliance checking with design pattern analysis and quality attribute assessment
questions.explanation: Automated compliance checking ensures consistent adherence to enterprise standards while comprehensive assessment covers all architectural dimensions.

questions.question: What is the primary benefit of implementing circuit breaker patterns in enterprise PEGA integrations?
options: Fault isolation, graceful degradation, and system stability during downstream failures
questions.explanation: Circuit breakers prevent cascading failures and maintain system stability by isolating faults and providing graceful degradation strategies.

questions.question: For enterprise architecture quality attributes, what assessment strategy ensures comprehensive evaluation?
options: Multi-dimensional assessment covering performance, scalability, security, maintainability, and testability
questions.explanation: Multi-dimensional quality assessment ensures all non-functional requirements are properly addressed in the architectural design and implementation.
